question: From what date do the new IT consultant rates apply?
gold_answer: 20-09-2023, per the 15-12-2023 clarification (not the 05-10-2023 GR date)

gold_grs_detail.title: Regarding Empanelment of Consultants for IT Projects in Government of Maharashtra.
Regarding Empanelment of Consultants for IT Projects in Government of Maharashtra - Clarification reg start date

product.answer: The new IT consultant rates apply from 20th September 2023, as clarified by the circular dated 15-12-2023. The 2018 GR stated its rates would apply for work orders issued after 20th March 2018, but the 2023 GR replaced those rates with a new table effective from 20th September 2023.
